## Working session summary

I'll wait for these runs to finish before doing anything further. Status so far:

**Pushed since resuming** (branch `issue-808-bf5af32dbcdd`, PR [#809](https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/pull/809)):

1. **R3/R5 adoption** — `scripts/simulate-fresh-merge.sh`, `scripts/check-secrets.sh` + `.secretlintrc.json` behind a new `secrets-scan` job, and `.github/actions/setup-buildx-resilient` replacing all three raw `docker/setup-buildx-action@v4` uses.
2. **Merged the 14 new `main` commits** (only conflict was `.gitkeep` timestamps) and rewrote the two new commit messages to the session id the evidence file records — `self-hosting-metric.rs --since main --until HEAD` now reports 18.86% (7/20 commits) instead of erroring.
3. **A real root cause the added instrumentation exposed.** The pull-request packaging dry run failed with *"Mounted app is missing its signed CodeResources envelope"* and the hook banner never printed. The packaging log shows `app-builder-lib`'s `isSignAllowed()` bailing with *"Current build is a part of pull request, code signing will be skipped"* — `builder-util`'s `isPullRequest()` is true whenever `GITHUB_BASE_REF` is set, so the custom `mac.sign` hook is never invoked. Fixed with `CSC_FOR_PULL_REQUEST: "true"` on the ad-hoc step only, where no signing secrets exist and the identity is `-`, so the flag's documented secret-leak concern does not apply.
4. **Workflow-invariant tests updated for the new jobs** (`evidence-check`, `docker-build`, `secrets-scan`), and the `always() && !cancelled()` assertion replaced along with the stale comments; `cargo test --test unit ci_cd::` is 131/131 green locally.
5. Analysis §7/§10 updated — including the correction that no template ships `.github/dependabot.yml`, so that row was never a real gap — plus changelog fragments and a rewritten PR title/description.

The PR is still a draft; I'll mark it ready once the runs on `ed943da` come back green (or investigate the logs if they don't).

## Working session summary

Both root causes found and fixed; CI is re-running (I'll report when it finishes).

**1. Secrets Scan** — the session transcript committed as evidence contained the workflow's ephemeral `GITHUB_TOKEN`. Redacted every GitHub token literal across *all* committed session logs (`dev/log/issues/781/pulls/803/` had the same leak, not just 808). Verified locally: `check-secrets.sh` → `No secrets found.`

**2. Build macos-x64 / macos-arm64** — upstream bug in `@electron/osx-sign` (`dist/cjs/sign.js:52`):

```js
function validateOptsIgnore (ignore) {
  if (ignore && !(ignore instanceof Array)) { return [ignore] }
}   // no `return ignore` for arrays → undefined
```

Passing an **array** of ignore rules silently discards all of them. That's why both existing mitigations failed at once — our hook passed an array, and electron-builder forwards `mac.signIgnore` as an array too — so codesign ran over the bundled Chrome for Testing framework and died with *"unsealed contents present in the root directory of an embedded framework"*. Confirmed in the log: the hook's entry banner printed but not a single per-file `ignore SKIP/sign` trace line, proving the predicate was never invoked.

Fix: `signingIgnoreRules()` now returns one composed predicate function (`desktop/scripts/adhoc-sign-mac.cjs:61`); `mac.signIgnore` stays as defence in depth. Tests updated plus a new test pinning the upstream quirk — `node --test` 4/4 pass.

Analysis appended to `dev/log/issues/808/pulls/809/analysis.md`; logs in `ci-logs/`. Commit a6f0f040 on PR https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/pull/809. Worth a one-line upstream PR to `electron/osx-sign` adding `return ignore`.

## Working session summary

Found and fixed the real root cause; CI is re-running (I'll report when the macOS builds finish).

**Root cause:** `desktop/scripts/prepare-resources.mjs` copied the Playwright Chromium directory with `fs.cpSync(from, to, { recursive: true })`. Node defaults `verbatimSymlinks: false`, which rewrites every symlink target to an **absolute** path — so the `Google Chrome for Testing Framework.framework` aliases inside the packaged app pointed at `~/.cache/ms-playwright/...`, outside the bundle. Signing itself now succeeded (the earlier ignore-rules fix worked), but `codesign --verify --deep --strict` then failed with `invalid destination for symbolic link in bundle` on both macos-x64 and macos-arm64.

**Changes** (commit `56fa089c`):
- `prepare-resources.mjs`: copy with `verbatimSymlinks: true`.
- `adhoc-sign-mac.test.cjs:70`: the lint job doesn't install `desktop/node_modules`, so `require.resolve('@electron/osx-sign/dist/cjs/sign.js')` threw `MODULE_NOT_FOUND` — that check now skips when the dependency is absent (this was the Lint failure).
- New `desktop/scripts/prepare-resources.test.mjs` regression test, wired into `desktop/package.json` and `.github/workflows/release.yml:463`.
- Evidence and analysis collected in `dev/log/issues/808/pulls/809/`.
